# Contributing

**Contribute to [RadioFoundry](https://github.com/radiofoundry/radiofoundry), not here.** Crucible is a downstream,
opinionated build of RadioFoundry for five radios. A fix or feature that helps any radio belongs upstream: everyone
gets it, it carries your name, and Crucible picks it up at the next merge. Start with RadioFoundry's
[contributing guide](https://github.com/radiofoundry/radiofoundry/blob/main/docs/dev/contributing.md).

Crucible doesn't take outside pull requests. These are welcome here:

- **Bug reports** about Crucible itself: something that works on RadioFoundry but not on Crucible, or anything in our
  releases or the [Crucible flasher](https://tinker.wc8mi.net/crucible/). If the bug is in RadioFoundry too, report it
  there.
- **Test reports** from Crucible's radios: what you checked, on which radio and release.

Security problems go through [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md), not an issue. Using this code in your own project:
[FORKING.md](/FORKING.md).
